title: Anthony:
title_short: Reel · Anthony · Nothing Was Gonna Stop Me
headline: He did his first FTC workshop as a prisoner. Coming back as a volunteer, he lost his license, his car broke and he forgot his ID. He drove four hours to get it. Nothing was going to stop him.
story: Anthony first heard about Freedom to Choose inside Valley State Prison. Now he is out and he always knew he wanted to go back in. The week of the workshop everything went wrong: license lost on a cruise, convertible top stuck open, then at check-in no ID. He drove two hours home and two hours back. The pull to come back is the story. It is funny, fast and true. The why: the volunteers do the work alongside the men, nobody tries to fix you.
Loops: L1 “What tried to stop him?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:38. L2 “Why go back in at all?” opens at 0:10 and closes at 0:50. Stakes: one workshop day, one missing ID, four hours of driving.
